unattributableMissions.note: root missions whose own level: field is missing, points to a level that is not shipped, or is the levels/water.bin dev placeholder; they were not guessed into any map

note: Airfields inside the exported base-map frame are in `airfields`; mission-defined airfields that lie outside that frame (legacy tank maps whose exported texture only covers the ~4 km battlefield) are kept in `airfieldsOutsideBaseMap` with reason flags.  altM is absolute world altitude, matrixAxesM are transformed local axis lengths (Box area size / Sphere radii along local axes).
